endpoints.truth_yaml:
put:
  operationId: updateTag
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-050000-put.workspaces.tags-happy-path.json
  x-notes: |
    clockify_tags_update performed a same-value no-op PUT on tag
    id=<redacted-id:0458fb1a5e> name='5. tag'. Returned 200 with full tag object.
    changedFields:[] confirms no actual mutation. Source: tags.go:133
    paths.Workspace(wsID, 'tags', tagID) with s.Client.Put (full replacement
    semantics). Payload: {name, archived} — Clockify requires name in the body.
    Ours-only path param name tagId vs official id is cosmetic.
  x-truth-iter: iter21
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
    - name: tagId
      in: path
      required: true
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          required: [name]
          properties:
            name:
              type: string
              maxLength: 150
            archived:
              type: boolean
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Updated tag object
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              id: {type: string}
              name: {type: string}
              archived: {type: boolean}
              workspaceId: {type: string}
endpoints.notes: LIVE-VERIFIED via clockify_tags_update no-op update. PUT /workspaces/{workspaceId}/tags/{tagId} returns 200 with full tag object. Full-replacement semantics: name is required in body. archived must be sent explicitly (no omitempty) per source comment in tags.go. MCP tool pre-fetches existing tag and merges fields before PUT.
